name: Range Analysis with Uniform Assumption
definition: A method that estimates the output value distribution of an INR over an input region by assuming each unit interval symbol represents a uniformly distributed random variable, then applying the Central Limit Theorem (CLT) to approximate the sum as a Gaussian distribution.
summary: Range Analysis with Uniform Assumption estimates INR output distributions by treating error terms as uniform variables, yielding less pessimistic bounds than vanilla range analysis.
